# CANDIDATE: BOS_VWAP_RIBBON_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A higher‑high market‑structure break that closes above VWAP with a bullish EMA ribbon (8>21>55) confirms strong upward momentum in trending regimes. This setup captures continuation entropy after a structural break, distinct from pure level breaks by requiring VWAP alignment and ribbon confirmation to filter false breakouts in choppy markets.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At bar close when: (1) price makes a higher high (HH) vs prior swing high, (2) close > VWAP, (3) 8-EMA > 21-EMA > 55-EMA.  
**Stop:** Prior swing low (most recent swing low before the HH bar).  
**Target:** Entry + 2×(entry−stop) (2R), unless named‑level resistance is closer, then use that level.  
**Exit:** Chart‑stop at prior swing low. If price reaches 1R, move stop to break‑even and trail runner at 20% off highest‑high‑since‑entry.  
**Regime filter:** Only active when VIX between 12‑22 and 55‑EMA slope upward; disabled when ribbon flat (|8-EMA−55-EMA| < 0.10).
